surface: Syrian Ministry of Awqaf Ramadan 1447 imsakiyya (printed sheet image, banked via the ministry's Instagram embed route by the predecessor; ministry Facebook post Feb 17, 2026 confirmed live via lite-DDG 2026-11-12)

extraction.method: per-cell crops on measured ruling grid, local Vision OCR fast level, threshold/mask variants + multi-read consensus; color-aware masks per column

column_attribution.F2_fajr: fajr; best single fixed angle ~18.85 deg (8-10/29 days exact, mae ~0.9 on adhan 4.4.6 at Damascus 33.5115/36.3064, UTC+3)
column_attribution.F1_sunrise: sunrise; residual 0 to -3 min across the month on adhan
column_attribution.E_dhuhr: dhuhr minus ~1 min (25/29 exact on adhan)
column_attribution.D_asr_12h: asr Shafi'i in 12-hour clock minus ~2.5 min (mae 0.68 on adhan)
column_attribution.B_sixth: UNLABELLED sixth numeric column; behaves as maghrib+78/79 min (wobble 78/79) or isha-equivalent ~18.5 deg minus ~6 min. The print carries no readable label for it; it is NOT recorded as isha. An imsakiyya-style product may carry such a column, but its semantics are not shown by the print.

no_isha_column_note: The sheet's labelled prayer set is not extractable (label bar unresolved by OCR). Five of the six numeric columns map to fajr/sunrise/dhuhr/asr/maghrib; the sixth's semantics are open. No column is claimed as isha.
engine_attribution: NOT PROVEN. Residual envelope +-3 min with a smooth month-scale drift on every column (sunrise 0..-3, maghrib -1..+2, asr -3..-1, dhuhr ~-1, fajr, sixth). PrayTimes-v2-family at Damascus (MWL 18/18, elv 0 or 690 m) does not close the envelope; adhan 4.4.6 does not reproduce at zero margins. The print's own engine/coordinates are not exposed by the image.

date_axis.primary: 1 Ramadan 1447 = Thu 2026-02-19 (National Crescent Committee announcement, snippet-level source)
date_axis.alternative: 2026-02-18 (preferred by ~1 min in pure adhan fit)

maghrib_check: Damascus sunset Feb 18 = 18:22 local; print day1 maghrib cell 06:21 (12h) = 18:21 = sunset - 1 min. Consistent.
